_note: dictionary: OpenCV ArUco dictionary name (DICT_4X4_50 is compact and robust at distance).
marker_length_m: physical side length of the printed ArUco marker in meters.
Measure the black border-to-border size of the printed marker.
valid_ids: list of marker IDs to accept. Empty list means accept all detected IDs.
camera_width, camera_height: must match camera_intrinsics.json image_size.
fps_target: attempted frame rate. Pi Zero 2W can typically do 5-10 fps at 1280x720 with ArUco.
uart_device: UART port for sending pose to 3pi+. /dev/ttyAMA0 is the primary UART on Pi Zero header.
uart_baudrate: must match camera_pose_serial.py on the 3pi+ side.
log_to_file: save detection log to a CSV file alongside the script.
annotate_display: draw axes and IDs on captured frames (useful for bench testing, costs CPU).
_selection_policy_note: nearest: send the closest valid marker by z_camera distance.
all: send all detected markers (one line per marker per frame).
lowest_id: send the marker with the numerically lowest ID.
